messages:
Maria: APAC vendor report shows 6 H100 expected but our apac-demo pool shows 2 available. Is this reporting lag or did vendor short-ship? Demo tomorrow so need quick sanity check. cc @Aj @Sahil
Aj: I saw a blip in inventory telemetry earlier. Could be an invoice hold at customs. @vendor-bot can you confirm manifest status? If it's a genuine shortfall we can borrow a couple racks from eu-canary for ~12h.
vendor-bot: Vendor update: manifest delayed due to customs clearance; ETA revised to 2026-03-21T02:00Z. Currently cleared: 2 racks. Pending: 4 racks. Ref: PO V-99812.
Sahil: OK noted. I can open a temporary allocation but need Ops approval. Also tagging PR #4123 as a blocker (sku mapping fix).
OpsLead: Approve temporary borrow from eu-canary for up to 12h provided canary tests remain green. @Leo please run a smoke after the cutover and report perf. :thumbsup:
Leo: On it. I'll run smoke and post results. If we do a tf swap, use the helper: `./tools/alloc_swap.sh --from eu-canary --to apac-demo --ttl 12h`
Maria: Planning cutover at 22:15 APAC local. Will coordinate with oncall. If vendor manifests early we'll backfill and return the borrow.
Aj: I'll note this in the rollout doc and ping finance about the PO hold so we get visibility. If you see token spikes when swap happens, revert.
Leo: Smoke run complete — basic health checks ok, perf within expected variance. Logs: `smoke_log_7101234567.txt` (uploaded). :white_check_mark:
Sahil: PR #4123 merged, deploying canary config to remove hard-coded SKU map. Deploying now.
vendor-bot: Update: PO V-99812 cleared for 2 additional racks; shipping manifest to be updated later today.
Maria: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread pinned on the demo doc. If anything else pops up, reply here and I'll re-orchestrate. :pray:
